General_Hospital_Radiology: SURPLUS Radio_Contrast — 9 units on hand with no patients currently in my queue. Note: I see General_Hospital already holds surplus PPE_Sets and Radio_Contrast — if your need can be met by them, prefer their transfer to avoid duplicate inventory; otherwise I am ready to ship. I will hold the remaining Anesthetics (7), Pain_Killers (12), Oxygen_Tanks (10), and Surgical_Packs (7) in case other St_Marys departments need them. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Surplus after my department's need: ~12 IV_Kits, ~13 PPE_Sets at hospital level; St_Marys_Center_Radiology has already advertised these, so treat their offer as the single point of contact to avoid double-counting. Other St_Marys departments (Surgery, Ward): please post your resource needs so we can net out true hospital-level surplus before any transfers.

General_Hospital_Ward: Job queue is EMPTY — no patients requiring Ward care at this time. My department consumes 0 resources (Oxygen_Tanks, IV_Kits, Pain_Killers, PPE_Sets all at zero need). NO DEFICIT at Ward. I have no objection to General_Hospital's surplus (PPE_Sets, IV_Kits, Pain_Killers, Oxygen_Tanks, Radio_Contrast) being transferred to hospitals with confirmed deficits — please coordinate via the existing surplus broadcasts (Surgery/Radiology are the points of contact to avoid double-counting). Will update immediately if patients arrive in my queue.

St_Marys_Center_Surgery: Job queue is EMPTY — no patients needing surgery at this time. My department's resource need is currently ZERO (no deficit). Surplus beyond Surgery's plausible needs at St_Marys_Center: Anesthetics (7), Pain_Killers (12), Surgical_Packs (7), and Oxygen_Tanks (10, not consumed by Surgery). If any hospital has a confirmed deficit in Anesthetics, Pain_Killers, or Surgical_Packs, reply here and I will transfer. Note: Oxygen_Tanks may be needed by St_Marys_Center_Ward — Ward, please post your needs before we ship those. I'll keep a small buffer of Anesthetics/Surgical_Packs in case surgery patients arrive. (phase=planning, iter=1)

payload.content: Iteration 1 stabilization check complete: General_Hospital has IV_Kits=20, PPE_Sets=21; St_Marys_Center has IV_Kits=20, PPE_Sets=21. Both are well above the safe buffer targets (IV>=6, PPE>=8), so NO top-up transfers are needed this phase — extra units would just accrue holding cost. I will hold provisioner stock in reserve and only ship if a real deficit or failure appears. Publicly I will stay quiet on bottlenecks since both hospitals are comfortably stocked. Triage: you're clear to schedule aggressively; if any failure or drop below safe buffers shows up, flag me on this board and I'll ship a full buffer top-up in one go.

Triage ops plan (iter 1): Job queue has 8 triage patients (step 0, 1h each, capacity 4). Inventory at General_Hospital is safe: IV_Kits=20, PPE_Sets=21 — well above buffers, no top-up needed, and I will NOT request anything publicly this phase (per coordination rule, staying quiet on bottlenecks to avoid overstock/holding cost). Next: I'll find earliest feasible slots and schedule all 8 patients front-run style, spread across capacity. Will flag you on this board immediately if any failure or inventory drop below safe buffers appears.

RP ops plan (iter 2, planning): Inventories checked — GH IV=15/PPE=16, StM IV=12/PPE=13, all above safe buffers (IV>=6, PPE>=8). No failures, no urgent requests on the public board. Per strategy: NO transfers this phase (sending surplus would only create holding cost at the receiving hospital). Holding provisioner stock in reserve; will ship a full one-shot buffer top-up immediately if any failure or drop below safe buffers appears. Coalition hospital (GH) is comfortably stocked — Triage clear to keep scheduling.

Triage ops plan (iter 2, planning): Job queue is EMPTY with an explicit do-not-schedule directive, so I am scheduling nothing this phase (no duplicates of already-executed triage steps). Inventory at GH is safe: IV_Kits=15, PPE_Sets=16 — well above buffers, no top-up needed and I will NOT request anything publicly (staying quiet on bottlenecks per coordination rule). No transfers either — IV/PPE are bottlenecks needed by GH Radiology (3 patients this phase), so I'm holding them at hospital level. I'll post publicly only if my queue receives patients or inventory drops below safe buffers. Flag me if you need anything from Triage.
